workstreams.name: CI and source verification
workstreams.execution: Run all module CI and the final read-only orchestrator; fix every compile, test, contract and static security failure.

workstreams.name: Stacked merge control
workstreams.execution: Merge parent-first only after each child is rebased or retargeted and its CI remains green.

workstreams.name: Seven-service deployment
workstreams.execution: Build immutable images and deploy all seven Spring services with every real worker, provider, mutation API and enforcement flag disabled.

workstreams.name: Database migration verification
workstreams.execution: Allow Flyway to apply owned-schema migrations service-by-service; verify history, constraints and rollback posture without cross-database access.

workstreams.name: Cloud routing and messaging
workstreams.execution: Configure Service Bus subscriptions, managed identities, APIM operations, Key Vault references and Container App secret bindings through guarded pipelines.

workstreams.name: Provider and Redis dependencies
workstreams.execution: Validate Redis, Firebase, FCM, ACS Email, Cashfree and delivery-provider credentials and callback registrations without enabling real execution early.

workstreams.name: Staged activation and rollback
workstreams.execution: Enable consumers before publishers, webhook ingress before its worker, payment APIs only after webhook readiness, and local account controls before Firebase workers; capture reverse-order rollback evidence.
evidence: rollback pipeline dry-run and controlled evidence

workstreams.name: Production validation
workstreams.execution: Complete authorization, security, load, backup/restore, observability and controlled real-provider field tests before go-live approval.

hardStops: Do not enable a provider, mutation API or worker because an environment is named production.
Do not invent pricing, commission, radius, refund, settlement, subscription grace or FSSAI values.
Do not merge a child before its parent.
Do not place secrets in Git, logs, pipeline parameters or chat.
Do not proceed after a failed readiness, health, audit or rollback gate.
